ra:high-order-skyborne:Walk on Air.d: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec, controlling your direction of travel.

ra:high-order-skyborne:Read Ley Line.d: Draw power from a nearby ley line, increasing Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 15 min near a ley line, or 15 sec without one.

ra:high-order-skyborne:Wind Blessed.d: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.

ra:high-order-skyborne:Elemental Insight.d: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

ra:human:Perception.d: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

ra:human:Sword Specialization.d: Swords increase spell and ability critical strike chance by 2%.

ra:dwarf:Find Treasure.d: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.

ra:dwarf:Stoneform.d: Removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

ra:dwarf:Mace Specialization.d: Maces increase spell and ability critical strike chance by 1%.

ra:night-elf:Elune's Light.d: Increases critical strike chance by 10% for 15 sec.

ra:night-elf:Elune's Grace.d: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

ra:night-elf:Shadowmeld.d: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using it in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but its cooldown increases to 2 min.

ra:night-elf:Quickness.d: 1% increased Dodge chance and 2% increased run speed. Rogues and Druids are also harder to detect while Stealthed, as though 1 level higher.

ra:night-elf:Wisp Spirit.d: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing speed by 75% while dead.

ra:gnome:Eureka!.d: Reduces the cost of your next 3 spells or abilities and increases their damage or healing by 10%.

ra:gnome:Engineering Specialization.d: Reduces the chance for your engineering devices to fail or backfire by 20%.

ra:gnome:Escape Artist.d: Instantly escape the effects of any movement-impairing effect and gain immunity to them for 3 sec.
